# B2 vocabulary batch 94

## Scope

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `infringement`, `inhabit`, `inherit`, `injection`, `innate`, `innocently`, `inseparable`, `inspirational`, `instill`, `insult`, `intent`, `interpersonal`, `interruption`, `intimate`, `intransitive`, `intravenous`, `intrude`, `intruder`, `intrusion`, `invariable`, `invariably`, `inventor`, `investigator`, `invisible`, and `invitingly`.

Each entry was manually reviewed for meaning, part of speech, Vietnamese gloss, example pair, IPA, level, and controlled topic assignment. The shared dictionary remains the single source for all exam lists.
